incident-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT DETECTED — Elevated tail latency (p99) for router-ingress in us-west-2. Auto-page sent to on-call.
Alex: oncall here, looking. seeing p95 ~220ms, p99 ~2.3s on the router tier. streaming stalls starting ~18:03 UTC.
Maria: confirmed from dashboard — sudden jump at 18:02. throughput steady, CPU/GPU healthy. latency correlation with a small subset of shards.
Sam: any error spikes? logs?
Alex: tail logs show a bunch of \"connection routed to cold-shard\" and repeated KV cache misses for keys in shard-7a. snippet:```2026-03-14T18:02:47Z router[shard=7a] WARN routing: assigned node offline? reassigning, latency=1.9s```
Lee: looks like router policy started favouring weights that map too many heavy keys to shard-7a — hot partition. could be rollout of new weight config at 17:59.
Pamela: :eyes: I deployed a rollout at 17:58 — a weight entropy tweak for region affinity. rolling back now?
Alex: yes, rollback to previous routing table (rev: rtbl-20260314-1752) as a quick mitigation. executing `rbctl rollback rtbl-20260314-1752 --apply`
eng-runtime-bot: deploybot: rollback job queued (job id jb-8921). ETA ~15s.
Maria: telemetry — after rollback p95 drops to ~160ms, p99 still ~1.2s but trending down. streaming stall rate reduced from 0.9% -> 0.4%.
Sam: still seeing occasional long tails for requests with prefix `/stream` from a handful of customer tokens. might be hotkey fragmentation + sticky hashing.
Alex: running live trace for an affected request:```TraceID: trc-8f1a - route->shard-7a -> node-34 -> retry -> fallback->node-18 -> success (2.4s)``` fallback path seems to incur big KV/kvcache miss thrash.
Pamela: thinking — enable eager fallback mode (weight-based fallback) for the router so we avoid retrying dead paths. what do you think?
Lee: agree. set policy to `fallback=eager` for ingress-usw2 for 5m. command: `routerctl set-policy ingress-usw2 fallback=eager --ttl=5m`
Alex: applied `fallback=eager` at 18:10:12 UTC. watching.
Maria: p99 down to 720ms within 90s of policy change. streaming stalls near-zero.
Sam: still want to investigate root cause — why did weight tweak cause hot mapping to shard-7a? counter: config diff shows weight for zone-usw2 shard bucket increased from 0.08 -> 0.32 for affinity rule id af-114.
Pamela: I patched af-114 to prefer regional locality, but didn't account for our hotkey distribution heatmap. my bad — missed the constraint on high-frequency prefixes.
Alex: customer impact assessment: about ~0.6% of total requests experienced >1s latency during the peak (18:02-18:11). 12 active customers had visible streaming stalls, 2 had degraded UX reports. no error codes 5xx observed.
eng-runtime-bot: incident-bot: page severity updated -> sev2. notify on-call eng-runtime.
Sam: grabbing traces for top 50 p99s and dumping hotkey histogram. `curl -s https://telemetry.internal/api/hotkeys?shard=7a | jq .top10` -> top keys dominated by a search prefix used by internal beta.
Maria: flagging beta tenant, reaching out to solutions-eng to reduce traffic or shard affinity for them. message to #customer-success queued.
Lee: action items so far: rollback routing table (done), enable eager fallback (done), limit affinity weight for af-114 to 0.12 (pending), create canary for weight rollouts.
Alex: can we put a temporary throttle on beta tenant while we fix mapping? `rate-limit set tenant:beta 50rps`
Pamela: throttle applied at 18:13:02 UTC. beta traffic dropped ~70% and tail normalized.
Sam: summary for oncall handoff: root cause is a config rollout that increased affinity weight without heatmap guard -> hot partitioning of shard-7a -> increased KV cache miss + retry thrash -> streaming tail latency. mitigations: rollback, eager fallback, throttle, weight cap.
Alex: preparing handoff to next oncall @Maria in 30m. leaving notes: `/incident notes add 3123456780 \"mitigations applied: rollback, eager fallback, throttle beta tenant, weight cap pending. follow-up: add heatmap validation to weight rollout, create canary, review af-114.\"`
Maria: ack, I'll pick this up. please ping runtime-eng for postmortem. tagging @eng-runtime-bot for ETA on a permanent fix.
eng-runtime-bot: runtime-team: create ticket RT-2026-342 (routing weight guard + canary) assigned to eng-runtime@oncall. ETA 3 business days.
Pamela: sorry about the ripple — will add heatmap check to my rollout process and put an automatic rollback if p99>800ms within 2 minutes.
Alex: final checks: p95/p99 stable at 140ms/210ms by 18:18. marking incident as mitigated.
incident-bot: Incident mitigated at 18:18:45 UTC. Please follow up with postmortem and customer comms if needed. :white_check_mark:
Maria: I'll own the postmortem and customer-impact notes. will include timeline, config diff, and action items.
Sam: adding logs and traces to the ticket RT-2026-342.
Lee: close loop: add automated heatmap validation to `rtctl rollout` and a canary that only increments weight by +0.05 every 5m.
Pamela: noted. thanks all for quick responses.
Alex: handing off, oncall clear.
Maria: taking over — will update channel when postmortem is ready.
incident-bot: This thread archived to incidents/after-action upon PM completion.
